title: Gradient flow
line: A slow-flowing mesh gradient, one huge number that rolls up, frosted glass capsules that fill like a chart, a single sheen of light.

beats.say: Three point two times more views.
beats.visual: On a flowing violet-orange gradient, 3.2× rolls up from 0.0× under a small caps label.
Three frosted glass capsules fill left to right, one after another, each with its value.
A sheen of light crosses the capsules; everything rests while the gradient keeps flowing.
